unit.name: ConflictDialog
unit.comment: Three-button modal: keep existing, merge, or override.
unit.body:
L001| return (
L002|   <Modal>
L003|     <Button onClick={() => onPick("keep")}>Keep</Button>
L004|     <Button onClick={() => onPick("override")}>Override</Button>
L005|   </Modal>
L006| );

note: comment promises three choices, the body offers two and there is no merge path

unit.name: hasReferenceData
unit.comment: Seeds the reference tables. Honours --if-empty so repeat runs don't re-parse. Idempotent upserts; silently skips files that aren't present.
unit.body:
L001| const [grading, credit] = await Promise.all([listGradingSystems(), listCreditSystems()]);
L002| return grading.length > 0 && credit.length > 0;

note: the docblock documents the seeding function below it; a helper was inserted between them

unit.name: buildGradingPatch
unit.comment: Refuses to copy a scale with no span between best and worst.
unit.body:
L001| if (scale.best === scale.worst) return { pass: scale.best / 2 };
L002| return { pass: midpoint(scale) };

note: nothing is refused: a degenerate scale is silently replaced with a fallback

unit.name: resolveAdminAccess
unit.comment: Resolves the caller's admin level from the invite list, or null when they are not an admin.

note: writes to the database on first authentication and the comment never says so

unit.name: renderReport
unit.body:
L001| writeFileSync("/tmp/last-report.txt", rows.length + " rows");
L002| return rows.map(fmt).join("\n");

note: comment claims purity, body writes a file

unit.name: pickSubCopy
unit.comment: Four cases, in order: 1. deadline this week 2. awaiting a decision 3. offer in hand 4. new user with no applications gets the onboarding nudge.

note: subtle: five outcomes not four, the no-apps check runs first, and the real fallback is undocumented
